texts: In CC-TGA the bundle of His runs anterosuperior to the membranous septum: C.
The regular posterior AV node does not connect; an anterior node gives a long, fragile bundle that runs above the pulmonary outflow and along the anterosuperior rim of a VSD.
This is why complete heart block is common, and why VSD stitches are placed on the morphological right ventricular side, away from the upper rim.
The sinus node is normal; in situs inversus the conduction system is more often normally posterior.
In the picture, the bundle runs above and in front of the drum skin, from a knot at the front.
Memory hook: in the mirror hotel, the sparks run over the top of the drum.
